title: Masculinities
description: Examines the various ways the question - who is a man? - can be answered by taking into account the intersections of race, sexualities, class and nationalism. Explores how these intersections are expressed in specific societal/historical contexts through power dynamics between "hegemonic masculinities" and a variety of subordinate manhoods.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GNDR 309, GNDR 329 (if taken in the same topic), WS 329 (if taken in the same topic).
